name: MetricStream
description: Connect your own MetricStream tenant (static API Key) to browse the Risk register, review and manage Issues, check Controls testing status and Assessments, and get an aggregated risk-posture report.

tools.name: connect_metricstream
tools.description: Connect a MetricStream tenant via a static API Key, after verifying connectivity.

label.description: Friendly tenant label, e.g. 'Acme Corp — Risk & Compliance'.
label.title: Label

api_key.description: MetricStream API Key, from MetricStream Admin.
api_key.title: Api Key

base_url.description: Your MetricStream instance URL, e.g. https://your-instance.metricstream.com.
base_url.title: Base Url

tools.name: disconnect_metricstream
tools.description: Disconnect a MetricStream tenant: deletes only the saved credentials. Nothing in MetricStream itself is changed.

connection_id.description: Saved MetricStream tenant connection ID to remove from Imperal.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_risks
tools.description: List Risks in the GRC Risk Register on the connected MetricStream tenant.

connection_id.description: Optional saved MetricStream tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_risk
tools.description: Read one Risk in full by id.

connection_id.description: Optional saved MetricStream tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List Issues raised against Risks, optionally filtered to one Risk.

connection_id.description: Optional saved MetricStream tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

risk_id.description: Optional MetricStream Risk ID to filter Issues to.
risk_id.title: Risk Id

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Read one Issue in full by id.

connection_id.description: Optional saved MetricStream tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new Issue, optionally linked to a Risk.

connection_id.description: Optional saved MetricStream tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

severity.description: Issue severity, e.g. LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL.
severity.title: Severity

risk_id.description: Optional MetricStream Risk ID this Issue relates to.
risk_id.title: Risk Id

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing Issue (status and/or severity). Only given fields change.

connection_id.description: Optional saved MetricStream tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_controls
tools.description: List Controls and their testing status on the connected MetricStream tenant.

connection_id.description: Optional saved MetricStream tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_control
tools.description: Read one Control in full by id.

connection_id.description: Optional saved MetricStream tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_assessments
tools.description: List compliance/risk Assessments configured on the connected MetricStream tenant.

connection_id.description: Optional saved MetricStream tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_assessment
tools.description: Read one Assessment in full by id.

connection_id.description: Optional saved MetricStream tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: audit_risk_posture
tools.description: Build a lightweight risk posture overview: open Issues by severity, high-risk Risks, Controls failing testing, and Assessment completion rate.

connection_id.description: Optional saved MetricStream tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

secrets.name: metricstream_connections
secrets.description: JSON list of connected MetricStream tenants and encrypted API Keys. Managed only through connect_metricstream and disconnect_metricstream.

pricing.notes: Standard platform scale {0, 8, 16, 20, 40}. 0 = access setup and harmless discovery. 8 = read/list/search. 16 = standard single mutation/CRUD. 20 = bulk or heavy audit operation.
